sentences.ar: جاري أبو نبيل كان يعزف عود من زمان.
sentences.en: My neighbor Abu Nabil used to play the oud long ago.

sentences.ar: كل مسا، كنا نسمع صوت عوده من الشباك.
sentences.en: Every evening, we would hear the sound of his oud from the window.

sentences.en: Once, I asked him: why are your melodies sad, uncle?
He put the oud beside him, and told me his story.
